description: Engine setup of map7_s02 (Nowhere - Alessa vs. Dahlia cutscene), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type ER2, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Stalker, GreyChild, Mumbler, Bloodsucker, Dahlia, EndingDahlia, Lisa, BloodyLisa, GhostChildAlessa, Kaufmann, EndingKaufmann and GhostDoctor). A mod changes it with its own maps/map7_s02/overlay.json.
